subject: MAP sync: renewal + expansion priorities and ops playbook
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: MAP kickoff: renewal + expansion priorities and ops playbook

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our agreement, I attached an updated mutual action plan that focuses on the renewal cadence and potential expansion lanes (new teams + usage-led add-ons). High-level goals for this MAP checkpoint:

- Confirm the timeline for procurement and legal review
- Align on enablement for the analytics and dev teams (RPs & owners)
- Prioritize feature-add vs seat expansion for Q1 2027

Action items I propose for this week:
1) ClearWave: confirm target deployment date for the pilot team (owner: Sara) — due by 2026-10-08
2) Redwood: provide a short usage report and recommended throttle/batching profile (owner: Ben) — due by 2026-10-06
3) Redwood: draft SLA exception terms for add-on GPUs if needed (owner: Karthik) — due by 2026-10-09
4) Mutual: schedule an enablement session for analytics (owner: Marissa) — proposed 2026-10-12

Attached: ClearWave_MAP_v2.xlsx (MAP with owners & dates) and redwood-usage-report-sep.pdf (requested usage baseline). Please reply with any edits to owners or dates; if that looks good I'll circulate a finalized MAP and a short one-page playbook for ops and success.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Account Exec, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: ClearWave_MAP_v2.xlsx (Excel)]

Sara —

I've attached a short appendix to the usage report showing token distribution and per-endpoint peaks. Key callouts:
- 75% of tokens originate from the triage-assistant endpoint (conversational), 15% from batch-embeddings, 10% from rerank and diagnostics
- Expected 2.5x peak during Monday morning batch runs; recommendation is to use a modest burst policy for those windows

Attachments: redwood-usage-report-sep.pdf (appended token appendix)

I'll also flag where continuous batching would reduce per-token cost vs strict low-latency routing. If you want, I can give a 15-minute walkthrough during the enablement session.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Customer Growth
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: renewal + expansion priorities and ops playbook

Sara / team —

Quick note on the SLA items: the majority are standard (uptime, incident response windows). Items that typically need negotiation for add-ons:
- Guaranteed p90 latency at peak when using burst GPUs (we can include an SLA but it will require a dedicated capacity commitment)
- Data residency / on-prem routing options (available in Private deployments; will add cost lines)
- Audit log retention beyond 13 months (we can extend but needs premium observability add-on)

I've started a draft of an "SLA exception terms" doc (attached) that calls out the tradeoffs and recommended price bands. If procurement needs a version with exact line items I'll move this to DocuSign after your legal sign-off.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SLA-exception-terms-draft.docx (Word)]
